description: This file provides utility functions for resolving, creating, and spawning pnpm commands within a Node.js environment, particularly tailored for cross-platform compatibility and safe command-line argument handling.

methods.name: resolvePnpmRunner
methods.description: Resolves the command and arguments to run pnpm, considering platform specifics and environment variables.

methods.name: createPnpmRunnerSpawnSpec
methods.description: Creates a spawn specification object with command, args, and options for spawning a pnpm process.

methods.name: spawnPnpmRunner
methods.description: Spawns a pnpm process using the specified parameters and returns the child process object.
